active_gate.detail: n=46 held-out strict-override states (>=30 required, sample size now sufficient). Sign agreement / precision = 45.7% (at/below chance, need clearly >50%). Mean actual paired win-rate delta = -0.0175 (need positive). 90% bootstrap CI = [-0.0581, 0.0217] (crosses zero, lower bound negative, need >=0). An earlier smaller sample (n=7) showed 85.7% precision and +0.152 mean delta; this did not replicate once sample size reached the required threshold, illustrating why the >=30 requirement exists.

label_fidelity_study.conclusion: Hypothesis B adopted: strategic effect not identifiable from current features/model. N=64 confident-label verification (475 states, new seeds 40000000/40001000) shows strict-subset precision=22.6%, mean actual delta=0.0005 (statistically zero), overall predicted-vs-actual correlation pearson=0.24/spearman=0.13.
